categories.introduction: The Sauce & Condiment Ontology catalogs canonical culinary sauces, condiments, spreads, emulsions, seasoning pastes, and fermented flavor bases used worldwide in cooking. This domain models culinary ingredients, not recipes, prepared dishes, marinades as recipes, beverage concentrates, or commercial brands.
categories.name: Sauces & Condiments
categories.seo_description: Explore canonical culinary sauces and condiments by group — culinary function, identity, and pairing metadata in the PairingMethod Food Ontology.
categories.summary: Canonical culinary sauces and condiments across six immutable groups: Mother Sauces, Table Sauces, Condiments, Fermented Sauces & Pastes, Oil-Based Sauces & Dressings, and Savory Spreads & Pastes.

groups.introduction: Mother Sauces in the Sauce & Condiment Ontology — foundational classical and emulsion sauces that anchor derivative sauce families, including béchamel, velouté, espagnole, tomato mother sauce, hollandaise, and mayonnaise.
groups.name: Mother Sauces
groups.seo_description: Canonical mother sauces — béchamel, velouté, hollandaise, and related foundational culinary sauces in the PairingMethod Sauce & Condiment Ontology.
groups.summary: Mother Sauces — 9 canonical sauce and condiment ingredients in the Sauce & Condiment Ontology.

groups.introduction: Table Sauces in the Sauce & Condiment Ontology — finished sauces served at the table or used as finishing components, including ketchup, barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and pan gravies.
groups.name: Table Sauces
groups.seo_description: Canonical table sauces — ketchup, barbecue sauce, Worcestershire, and related finishing culinary sauces in the PairingMethod Sauce & Condiment Ontology.
groups.summary: Table Sauces — 22 canonical sauce and condiment ingredients in the Sauce & Condiment Ontology.

groups.introduction: Condiments in the Sauce & Condiment Ontology — concentrated flavor carriers used in small quantities at the table or during finishing, including mustards, relishes, and prepared condiment pastes with established culinary identity.
groups.name: Condiments
groups.seo_description: Canonical condiments — Dijon mustard, relish, and related table condiments in the PairingMethod Sauce & Condiment Ontology.
groups.summary: Condiments — 20 canonical sauce and condiment ingredients in the Sauce & Condiment Ontology.

groups.introduction: Fermented Sauces & Pastes in the Sauce & Condiment Ontology — fermented and aged flavor bases used as sauces or seasoning pastes, including soy sauce, fish sauce, and gochujang. Legume- and grain-derived ferments owned by other domains are referenced, not duplicated.

groups.introduction: Oil-Based Sauces & Dressings in the Sauce & Condiment Ontology — emulsified and oil-forward sauces and dressings used in salads, finishing, and cold applications, including vinaigrette, pesto, aioli, and ranch dressing.

aroma_profile.description: Reserved aroma characteristic tags — vocabulary frozen in FOOD-13A; do not populate until post-FOOD-13B curation standards.

canonical_culinary_groups.description: Immutable group names and slugs — do not rename or add peer groups in v1.

culinary_function.description: Primary culinary functions exercised by the sauce or condiment in finished dishes — frozen vocabulary for pairing and audit context.

culinary_group.description: Canonical Culinary Group value on leaf entities — aligns to immutable group slugs.

flavor_profile.description: Reserved flavor characteristic tags — vocabulary frozen in FOOD-13A; do not populate until post-FOOD-13B curation standards.

texture_profile.description: Reserved texture characteristic tags — vocabulary frozen in FOOD-13A; do not populate until post-FOOD-13B curation standards.

usage_intensity.description: Intrinsic culinary prominence in dish composition — not Pairing Engine reasoning.

domain_exclusions.beverage_concentrates: Beverage concentrates and drink bases — out of domain v1
domain_exclusions.brands: Commercial brands and product lines — not ingredient ontology
domain_exclusions.dishes: Finished dishes and composed meals — not ingredient ontology
domain_exclusions.fruit: FOOD-09 — whole and fresh fruit forms
domain_exclusions.herb_spice: FOOD-07 — whole spices, dried herbs, and spice blends owned by Herb & Spice
domain_exclusions.legume: FOOD-11 — whole legumes and legume products owned by Legume (miso, hummus, etc.)
domain_exclusions.marinades_as_recipes: Marinades defined as recipes — not ingredient ontology v1
domain_exclusions.nut_seed: FOOD-10 — whole nuts, seeds, and nut-seed products (tahini, peanut butter)
domain_exclusions.recipes: Recipes and composed meals — not ingredient ontology
domain_exclusions.spice_blends: Spice blends owned by Herb & Spice — garam masala, curry powder, five-spice, etc.
domain_exclusions.sweet_flavor: FOOD-12 — crystalline sweeteners, syrups, and primary sweet ingredients

sauce_condiment.description: Canonical culinary sauce or condiment leaf entity.

sauce_condiment_category.description: Top-level sauce and condiment domain hub (single category in v1).

sauce_condiment_group.description: Canonical Culinary Group (Mother Sauces, Table Sauces, Condiments, etc.).

botanical_ownership_rule.note: Suite rule — applies when botanical lineage diverges from culinary identity.

composite_identity_rule.description: A sauce or condiment becomes canonical only when it has an established culinary identity independent of its ingredient list.

composition_ownership_rule.description: Ingredient ownership never transfers — sauce entities reference canonical IDs from other domains without duplicating intrinsic metadata.

culinary_function_pairing_rule.description: Wine pairing follows culinary function — acidity, fat, fermentation, emulsification, umami, richness — not dominant ingredient alone.

functional_pairing_rule.note: Suite wine-pairing rule — referenced for completeness.

processing_ownership_rule.description: When processing creates a distinct canonical culinary ingredient versus a preparation state or alias.

schema.taxonomy_note: Groups represent culinary function, not geography or primary ingredient. See docs/SAUCE_CONDIMENT_GOVERNANCE.md.
